summary: Implemented App.call_from_thread in src/textual/app.py with the thread-entry state (loop reference and thread id) initialized in the constructor and set/cleared in the run_app coroutine's try/finally. Added tests/test_concurrency.py with 9 tests; all pass when run with PYTHONPATH pointing at the repo's src/, because the shared venv's editable textual install points at the base checkout. Nothing committed. Not verified: full test suite, and Python 3.7 compatibility (checked by reading only; the run used Python 3.9). Pre-existing failures in test_unmount, test_screens, and test_call_later (async tests without an async pytest plugin) occur on the unmodified baseline too.
